B.domain: Subtracting fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Match denominators
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and rewrite fraction parts as equivalent fractions before subtraction when the denominators do not already match.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when fraction parts are converted to equivalent fractions to enable subtraction.
Tag for unlike-denominator fraction subtraction and unlike-denominator mixed-number subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag steps that only subtract numerators after denominators already match.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as x + 0/n unless it is part of creating a common denominator by explicit conversion.

skills.name: Normalize operands
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole or mixed-number operand into a subtraction-ready form, such as converting an improper mixed number to a standard mixed number or expressing a whole number as a whole plus a zero-fraction part.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number with an improper fractional part is normalized, such as 2 3/2 to 3 1/2.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0/n, such as 3 to 3 + 0/5.
Tag when a mixed number or fraction is decomposed into whole and fractional parts to align the operands for part-by-part subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction of already-ready whole and fraction parts.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping after subtraction has produced a negative fractional part.
Do not tag simplification of the final answer.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with matched denominators and/or subtract the whole-number and fractional parts of mixed numbers once the operands are in compatible form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a common denominator.
Tag when whole parts and fraction parts of mixed numbers are subtracted separately.
Tag when the subtraction step may temporarily produce a negative fractional part before any borrowing.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is finding a common denominator or converting equivalent fractions.
Do not tag steps whose main purpose is rewriting operands into standard form.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping steps that adjust a negative fractional result.
Do not tag simplification-only steps.

skills.name: Regroup and simplify
skills.definition: Resolve a negative fractional part by borrowing from the whole number and reduce the resulting fraction or mixed number to lowest terms, including simplifying to a whole number or zero when appropriate.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when 1 is borrowed from the whole part and converted to n/n for the fraction part.
Tag when the borrowed unit is added to the fractional part before re-subtracting.
Tag when a fraction or mixed number is reduced to lowest terms, including forms like 2/10 to 1/5, 0/3 to 0, or 1 9/12 to 1 3/4.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag straightforward subtraction that does not require borrowing and does not include simplification.
Do not tag finding common denominators.
Do not tag initial rewriting of operands before subtraction.

A.domain: Subtracting fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Match denominators
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and rewrite fractional parts as equivalent fractions before subtraction when the denominators do not already match.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD/LCM/common denominator.
Tag when a step converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions with the same denominator.
Tag for mixed-number subtraction if only the fractional parts are rewritten to a common denominator.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag simple rewriting of a whole number as n + 0/d unless it is part of creating a needed common denominator and equivalent fraction conversion is shown.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping steps.

skills.name: Normalize mixed forms
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or nonstandard mixed number into compatible whole-and-fraction parts before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0/d.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fractional part is normalized to a standard mixed number.
Tag when a mixed number is explicitly decomposed into whole and fractional parts to align the subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction of already compatible fractions or mixed numbers when no rewriting is done.
Do not tag finding a common denominator unless the step also rewrites the number form itself.
Do not tag borrowing one whole into fractional units after subtraction has begun.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with matched denominators and/or subtract the whole and fractional parts of mixed numbers once the forms are aligned.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted for fractions with the same denominator.
Tag when whole parts are subtracted in a mixed-number problem.
Tag when fractional parts are subtracted after denominators have been matched or shown equal.
Tag when the result is combined from the computed whole and fractional parts without regrouping.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is to create common denominators.
Do not tag rewriting/normalizing steps before subtraction.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping steps used to fix a negative fractional part.
Do not tag simplification-only steps such as reducing 2/10 to 1/5 or 0/3 to 0.

skills.name: Regroup and simplify
skills.definition: Borrow one whole into fractional units when the fractional subtraction is negative, and reduce the resulting fraction or zero to lowest terms.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step borrows 1 from the whole part and converts it to d/d for the fractional part.
Tag when a step adds a full denominator unit such as 12/12, 24/24, or 5/5 to continue subtraction.
Tag when a step simplifies a fraction or zero result to lowest terms after subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag straightforward subtraction when no borrowing or simplification occurs.
Do not tag finding a common denominator or equivalent-fraction conversion.
Do not tag initial rewriting of whole numbers or improper mixed numbers before subtraction.

C.domain: Subtracting fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Align fractional forms
skills.definition: Rewrite quantities so the fractional parts are in a compatible form for subtraction, including finding a common denominator or expressing a whole number as 0 over a denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution finds an LCD/common denominator and converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0 over the relevant denominator (for example, 3 as 3 + 0/5 or 2 as 2 + 0/8) to align parts for subtraction.
Tag when the step explicitly converts fractional parts so both subtrahend and minuend can be subtracted part-by-part.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no rewriting is done.
Do not tag pure normalization of an improper mixed number into a standard mixed number; that belongs to S02.
Do not tag the actual subtraction after forms are aligned; that belongs to S03.

skills.name: Normalize mixed numbers
skills.definition: Convert a nonstandard mixed number with an improper fractional part into an equivalent standard mixed number before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number such as 2 3/2, 2 4/3, or 1 5/3 is rewritten into an equivalent standard mixed number.
Tag when the solver explicitly carries extra wholes from an improper fractional part into the whole-number part before subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary common-denominator conversions; those belong to S01.
Do not tag borrowing during subtraction; that belongs to S04.
Do not tag straightforward subtraction of already standard mixed numbers or fractions; that belongs to S03.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with like denominators and/or subtract the whole and fractional parts of mixed numbers once the quantities are in compatible form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a shared denominator.
Tag when whole parts and fractional parts of mixed numbers are subtracted directly.
Tag when the solver combines the resulting whole and fractional parts into the final mixed number or fraction after direct subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is creating common denominators or rewriting wholes as 0 over a denominator; those belong to S01.
Do not tag normalization of improper mixed numbers; that belongs to S02.
Do not tag regrouping/borrowing because the fractional subtraction would otherwise be negative; that belongs to S04.

skills.name: Borrow across parts
skills.definition: Regroup one whole into fractional units to complete subtraction when the fractional part of the minuend is smaller than the fractional part of the subtrahend.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution notes a negative fractional difference and then borrows 1 from the whole part.
Tag when 1 whole is converted into denominator-over-denominator form such as 5/5, 10/10, 12/12, or 24/24 and added to the fractional part.
Tag when the borrowed amount is then used to finish the fractional subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag direct subtraction that does not require regrouping.
Do not tag initial rewriting of a whole number as 0 over a denominator; that belongs to S01.
Do not tag normalization of improper mixed numbers before subtraction; that belongs to S02.
